name: OpenOS 1.6.0
description: Bluetooth Classic is gone: it took 740 KB of the 2 MB image and 80 KB of heap while on, so the image is now 1.3 MB and applications get about three times the free memory (110 KB with the reserve held). OSA SDK 6 adds raw building blocks: byte buffers (buf.*), TCP and UDP sockets (net.*, udp.*) and pixel access to the screen and sprites (screen.read/write, gfx.read/write) - the Cast Receiver app shows a computer screen with them. sys.info exposes hardware facts for the redesigned About device screen. Home has three pages of twelve tiles (swipe sideways, hold and drag to move, carry a tile to the edge for the next page); closing an app folds it into its tile colour and returns to Home in about 150 ms - script headers, bytecode loads and the card rescan were all made lazy or block-based. Scripts may now be 768 lines. Update Home, Control Center and Settings from OpenStore after installing.
